concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-010 (sensitivity analysis over density‑weightings and solver α values) has no corresponding task. The task list ends at T025 (documentation polish) and does not include a dedicated task to execute, log, and evaluate the sensitivity runs required by the spec.

Success Criterion SC-002 (regime‑map PNG must be ≤ 5 MB) is not verified by any task. Existing tasks T017 and its contract tests check PNG existence and pixel variance but do not enforce the size limit, leaving the criterion uncovered.
